mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_prize_pool (name, description, coupon_id, total_stock, claimed_count, per_user_limit, per_user_daily_limit, daily_limit, start_time, end_time, status, banner_text, banner_color, banner_color_end, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{couponId}, #{totalStock}, 0, #{perUserLimit}, #{perUserDailyLimit}, #{dailyLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{bannerText}, #{bannerColor}, #{bannerColorEnd}, #{sort})
mapper.update:
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool
name = #{name}, description = #{description}, coupon_id = #{couponId}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, per_user_daily_limit = #{perUserDailyLimit}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, banner_text = #{bannerText}, banner_color = #{bannerColor}, banner_color_end = #{bannerColorEnd}, sort = #{sort},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET claimed_count = claimed_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (total_stock = -1 OR claimed_count < total_stock)
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT , ct.id AS ct_id, ct.name AS ct_name, ct.type AS ct_type, ct.face_value AS ct_face_value, ct.discount AS ct_discount, ct.min_spend AS ct_min_spend, ct.total_count AS ct_total_count, ct.issued_count AS ct_issued_count, ct.per_limit AS ct_per_limit, ct.valid_type AS ct_valid_type, ct.valid_start AS ct_valid_start, ct.valid_end AS ct_valid_end, ct.valid_days AS ct_valid_days, ct.status AS ct_status FROM marketing_prize_pool p LEFT JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = p.coupon_id AND ct.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY p.sort DESC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.banner_text, p.banner_color, p.banner_color_end, p.description, p.sort, p.coupon_id FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY p.sort DESC

SELECT , ct.id AS ct_id, ct.name AS ct_name, ct.type AS ct_type, ct.face_value AS ct_face_value, ct.discount AS ct_discount, ct.min_spend AS ct_min_spend, ct.total_count AS ct_total_count, ct.issued_count AS ct_issued_count, ct.per_limit AS ct_per_limit, ct.valid_type AS ct_valid_type, ct.valid_start AS ct_valid_start, ct.valid_end AS ct_valid_end, ct.valid_days AS ct_valid_days, ct.status AS ct_status FROM marketing_prize_pool p LEFT JOIN coupon_template ct ON ct.id = p.coupon_id AND ct.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.sort DESC, p.create_time DESC
